secrets.name: The Relief Order
secrets.hint: At the Barbican, something underfoot is not as it was laid.
secrets.found: Under the stone, wrapped in oilcloth: an order nobody carried the last hundred paces.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: That one has been lifted before. Often, and carefully.

secrets.solution: Tap the pale, tilted flagstone to the right of the path at the Barbican.

secrets.name: The Second Candle
secrets.hint: The chapel alcove changes once the gate has no keeper.
secrets.found: A second candle stands beside the first. It is the same kind, and gives the same light without heat.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: I did not light that one. I want that understood.

secrets.solution: After the Ashen Sentinel has fallen, return to the chapel alcove and tap the new, cold-blue candle on the ground to the left.

secrets.name: A Charcoal Sketch
secrets.hint: Somebody left their working-out in the gate passage.
secrets.found: A square of hide, rolled tight and pushed into a crack: a charcoal drawing of a spring under a hanging tree.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: A drawing. Not of here. Keep it. Somebody wanted a place found again.

secrets.solution: Tap the rolled hide wedged between two stones on the left of the gate passage.

secrets.name: The Lamplighter's Round
secrets.hint: On the Lantern Road, count what is lit and what is not.
secrets.found: The one dark lantern takes light from your hand and holds it. Inside the cage is a strip of bark, cut with marks.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It was only waiting to be asked. Everything here is still waiting to be asked.

secrets.solution: Tap the one unlit lantern standing low by the left of the Lantern Road.

secrets.name: The Shaded Stone
secrets.hint: A drawing found elsewhere shows this spring from the artist's side.
secrets.found: Under the middle stone, a tin of blacking and a rag: a soldier's kit, kept dry for three centuries.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: The middle one. Exactly as it was drawn. Somebody trusted a stranger to look closely.

secrets.solution: Holding the charcoal sketch from the Courtyard's gate passage, tap the row of three stones left of the spring under the gibbet tree.
secrets.locked_text: Three stones in a row by the water. They mean nothing to you yet.

secrets.name: The Trimmed Posts
secrets.hint: Four marker posts stand about the woodpile. A lamplighter once wrote down how they are tended.
secrets.found: Each post warms under the hand in turn. At the fourth, all of them light, low and steady, along a road that was never cut.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: The fourth one lit. They were never markers. They are the lamps for a road nobody finished.

secrets.solution: Touch the four posts at the Woodpile in the order the Lamplighter's Round gives: tall, split, leaning, short.

secrets.name: End of the Cylinder
secrets.hint: The hymn in the choir loft is not as endless as it sounds.
secrets.found: The hymn runs out. In the silence a flat voice reads a batch number and a date, and the hymn begins again.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It stopped. And then it said a number. Hymns do not end with a number.

secrets.solution: Stand in the Choir Loft for sixteen seconds without acting.

secrets.name: A Name You Answer To
secrets.hint: The reliquary lamp asks nothing. It does, given time, say something.
secrets.found: The lamp murmurs, too low to catch, and then quite clearly says a name. It is not yours. You answer to it anyway.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It said a name. You turned your head. You turned before I had finished hearing it.

secrets.solution: Sit by the reliquary lamp for eighteen seconds without acting.

secrets.name: Unshielded at the Summit
secrets.hint: The footprints fused into the Glass Road belonged to someone who carried less than you do.
secrets.found: The sky is very large, and you met it with a blade and nothing else.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: There are two footprints fused into the glass road below. Whoever made them carried no shield either. You walked down again.

secrets.solution: Defeat the Cinder Wyrm with no shield equipped.

secrets.name: Twice Yourself
secrets.hint: On the Wall Walk somebody practised alone for an age. Ask what against.
secrets.found: It has your stance, your reach, and your habit of dropping the point. When it breaks, it breaks exactly the way you would.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: That is a Recall surface. It is not showing you. It is playing you back.

secrets.solution: After beating the Rime Duelist, return to the Wall Walk and tap the slab of black ice standing on the left. Beat the reflection that steps out of it.

secrets.name: Who Carried It
secrets.hint: The Last Candle was set down by someone. One of your companions could say who.
secrets.found: In the wax at the candle's foot is the print of a thumb, small, pressed in while it was warm.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: I know that hand. She carried it down herself, when she could still carry. Lyra, you were told you had never left the sanctuary.

secrets.solution: With the Witness found, tap the small cold candle on the left at the fourth stop of the Deep (Mark the Way and the Last Candle).

secrets.name: The Parade Sword of the Ninth Jubilee
secrets.hint: The Treasury was emptied by people with taste. They left one thing.
secrets.found: It is enormous, gilded, and enamelled with the faces of nine kings. It could not cut bread. Three hundred years of looters have walked past it.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: I was present when it was presented. The applause was the bravest thing I ever saw at court.

secrets.solution: Tap the gaudy gilt sword propped on the left in the Antechamber.

secrets.name: The Cycle Count
secrets.hint: The Breach looks different to someone who has already seen how this ends.
secrets.found: A line of small cuts in the fallen wall, at eye height, and a fresh one at the end. It is made with the edge you are carrying.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: That mark was not there the first time. Or it was, and you could not see it yet. I do not know which frightens me more.

secrets.solution: Finish the story, begin a New Game Plus, and at the very first stop of the Courtyard tap the blade standing in the rubble on the right.

hints.stops: A stretch of this road has not been walked on foot.
hints.guardians: Something here has not been faced.
hints.lore: A record on this road is unread.
hints.missions: A task in the Journal is unfinished.

t_second_candle.name: The Second Candle
t_second_candle.text: A light that came by itself after the gate lost its keeper.

t_trimmed_wick.name: A Trimmed Wick
t_trimmed_wick.text: From the lamps of a road nobody finished.

t_glass_footprints.name: Cast of Two Footprints
t_glass_footprints.text: Taken from the glazed road under the Roost.

t_parade_sword.name: The Parade Sword of the Ninth Jubilee
t_parade_sword.text: Too ugly to steal. Hung where Orren does not have to look at it.

t_cycle_tally.name: A Rubbing of the Tally
t_cycle_tally.text: The marks at the breach, in charcoal. All in one hand.

t_three_quarter.name: The Witness's Pen
t_three_quarter.text: He says he will not need it for a while.

t_complete.name: The Empty Plinth
t_complete.text: A plinth with no statue. There is nothing left to put on it that you have not seen.
